profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed key features of user creation and task assignment web application using ReactJS and Django framework for AWS-serviced database to service internal team and thousands of external clients. 
•	Updated Wagtail CMS with HTML, CSS, Python, and JavaScript in line with feedback and requests from partner Clean Water for US Kids project team.
positions.insights: Django REST Framework, JavaScript and +3 skills

positions.title: Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs Intern
positions.description:
• Migrated employees from outdated Windows virtual machine to newest version
• Enabled regulatory team to meet merger processing deadline by designing 20+ EPA labels
• Implemented formulas to organize Excel sheets of a 1000+ products 
• Calculated cheapest product registration costs for products in 20+ states

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
• Expedited daily shipments through improved inventory organization system of 1,500+ parts
• Overhauled 200+ sales catalogues and floor displays – creating a timelier process for sales team
• Maintained, cleaned, and organized a 37,000 square foot plus warehouse
• Verified and logged 50 – 100 shipments data in company database

educations.schoolName: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

volunteerExperiences.description: Leader and Mentor within the non-profit youth organization, Younglife, serving middle grade students in the local Chapel Hill community. Ten plus hours a week committed to creating a consistent and enriching environment for students to foster lifelong relationships and serve the community. Led a team of four to develop and stage weekly events for students.
